instruction.text: Are the following statements true or false?

atoms.a: An axle is another name for a wheel.
Gears all have the same size of teeth.
Pulleys can have multiple wheels attached.

instruction.text: Select the mechanism these everyday examples use.

atoms.b: Pulleys run rope along a ((++wheel bar)) that is connected to an axle.
One end of the rope is connected to a ((++load pivot)), and the other can be pulled.
The more wheels there are in a pulley, the ((++easier harder)) it is to lift the load.
A gear is a special wheel that has ((++teeth fingers)) around its outer edge
A moving gear will cause other gears that connect to it to turn in the ((++opposite same)) direction.
To go faster on a bike, you would change to a ((larger ++smaller)) gear on the back wheel.
A lever is a simple mechanism that uses a ((++bar car)) to pivot around a fixed point.
The fixed point of a lever is called a ((++pivot piston)).
The length of a lever can increase the force of the ((++effort strain)) placed on the load.
